custom_logic_notes: EA uses CExpert framework with CSignalRabbit3 custom signal class. The Rabbit3 indicator is loaded via iCustom. Signal conditions are computed inside CSignalRabbit3::LongCondition and CSignalRabbit3::ShortCondition methods. The EA relies on the Standard Library CExpert engine for trade management, position tracking, and order execution. Since the source file is binary/unreadable, the internal logic of the Rabbit3 indicator cannot be fully determined from this file alone.
python_conversion_notes: Must reverse-engineer or obtain the Rabbit3 custom indicator source to replicate signal logic in Python. The CExpert framework provides standard position management that maps to a simple market-order engine. SL/TP are fixed-pip values. The CSignalRabbit3 class wraps iCustom('Rabbit3') calls - need to understand what buffers the indicator exposes and what thresholds trigger LongCondition/ShortCondition. Without the indicator source, Python conversion requires either: (1) obtaining the .mq5 source of Rabbit3 indicator, or (2) running the indicator in MT5 and exporting signals for supervised learning replication.
